class.name: PhysXBlastAuthoring
class.brief_description: Fractures meshes into Blast assets for [PhysXDestructible3D].
class.description: Breaks a mesh into chunks with NVIDIA Blast's authoring tools and cooks their collision hulls, producing a [PhysXBlastAsset]. Create one with [code]PhysXBlastAuthoring.new()[/code] and call [method fracture_mesh].

method.name: fracture_mesh
method.description: Fractures surface 0 of [param mesh] and returns the result, or [code]null[/code] on failure. [param pattern] picks the algorithm (see [enum FracturePattern]). [param site_count] is about how many pieces to make (approximate for [constant PATTERN_SLICING], ignored for [constant PATTERN_CUTOUT]); [param seed] makes the result repeatable. [param cutout_pattern] is the grayscale crack image [constant PATTERN_CUTOUT] needs: every crack line must reach the image border.

constants.constant: Random Voronoi cells: organic, rock-like chunks.
Cuts along planes on all three axes: regular, brick-like pieces for crates, walls and other man-made objects.
Extrudes a 2D crack pattern (the [code]cutout_pattern[/code] texture) through the mesh, for glass panes, brick walls or any authored break-up shape.
